Hats off a slow finish
Readers will enjoy spare blankets
Quiet Care for traveling companions

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways keeps each animal journey orderly and reassuring. Staff members prepare documents, confirm carrier fit, and guide travelers through check-in with steady, respectful service. Calm handling is central to every interaction, and the welcome team works to reduce noise, delay, and confusion wherever possible.

Clear communication helps the desk support pets and their owners from first contact through boarding. When a concern arises, the team answers promptly, records details accurately, and follows humane procedures without exception. This careful routine helps build trust and supports safe movement for every companion animal.
